definitions.explanation: The act of traveling regularly between home and workplace.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}で{通勤|つうきん}しています。
examples.english: I commute to work by train.

examples.japanese: {通勤|つうきん}{時間|じかん}は{片道|かたみち}{一時間|いちじかん}です。
examples.english: My commute is one hour each way.

examples.japanese: {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュは{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: The rush hour commute is tough.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{通勤|つうきん}する (to commute to work)
・〜で{通勤|つうきん}する (to commute by ~)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{通勤|つうきん}{電車|でんしゃ} (commuter train)
・{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ (rush hour)
・{通勤|つうきん}{定期|ていき} (commuter pass)
・{通勤|つうきん}{時間|じかん} (commute time)
・{通勤|つうきん}{手当|てあて} (commuting allowance)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ (rush hour) is famous for extremely crowded trains, especially in Tokyo. Many companies provide {通勤|つうきん}{手当|てあて} (commuting allowance) to employees.
